heroSubline: Gamma Sigma Chapter at the University of Maryland, Robert H. Smith School of Business.
introStatement: A co-ed professional business fraternity where brothers from different backgrounds build each other up, in class, in their careers and long after Maryland.

pillars.name: Brotherhood
pillars.text: We support brothers holistically, from chapter-wide dinners and gatherings to showing up for each other outside of DSP.

pillars.name: Service
pillars.text: Every semester we read to elementary schoolers, mulch trees, run business workshops for high schoolers and more.

pillars.name: Professionalism
pillars.text: Networking events, resume reviews, panels, mock interviews and workshops, held every semester.

pillars.name: Scholarship
pillars.text: Fifteen executive positions, a LEAD conference every semester and Grand Chapter Congress every other year.

president.title: From our president
president.name: Elle McNees
president.letter:
I thank you for taking interest in Delta Sigma Pi, America’s forefront co-ed business fraternity. At the University of Maryland, Robert H. Smith School of Business, our Gamma Sigma chapter is a phenomenal representation of our fraternity’s four pillars: brotherhood, professionalism, scholarship, and service. Here, we assume a great social responsibility and thus are committed to prioritizing diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging among our brothers and our fellow organizations at the University of Maryland. Coming from different backgrounds and unique experiences, we have created and cultivated a support system built around understanding and familial knowledge.

The Gamma Sigma chapter has maintained a fantastic brotherhood consisting of over 75 brothers who consistently uplift and motivate each other in every way they are able. The strength in the brotherhood creates bonds that extend far past the University of Maryland.

On behalf of the Gamma Sigma Chapter, I gladly welcome you to discover the fraternity’s values and learn what makes us proud to wear Delta Sigma Pi’s iconic purple and gold.
